primary_model: B average: mean log-odds of B1 and B2
calibration: none (raw model output; rescaling did not help in 2020-24)
fit_window: all decided fights before 2025-01-01 (B1 from 2015, B2 from 2013-02-16)
scoring_set: decided fights with usable opening and closing odds (market_ok)

pass_rule.1: log loss lower than the opening odds, 95% event-bootstrap interval of the difference below zero
pass_rule.2: log loss lower than the stretched opening odds (slope fitted before 2025), interval below zero
pass_rule.3: mean closing-line value of the bets above zero, interval above zero
pass_rule.note: betting return is reported but is not part of the pass rule (too noisy on one test window)
